# Audio layout fixtures

Small container files for the audio file layout report (`pulp audio inspect`
and `pulp::audio::inspect_audio_file_layout`). Each is under 32 KB and starts
from a synthetic 8 kHz, 0.1 s sine that `generate.py` writes itself, so the
set carries no third-party audio.

License: generated by Pulp, MIT.

| File | Generator | What it exercises |
|------|-----------|-------------------|
| `tone.aiff` | `afconvert -f AIFF -d BEI16` | FORM/AIFF with COMM, Apple `FLLR` padding, SSND |
| `tone.aifc` | `afconvert -f AIFC -d BEI16` | FORM/AIFC with a `NONE` compression type and FVER |
| `tone.flac` | `flac --no-padding -T TITLE=…` | STREAMINFO, SEEKTABLE, VORBIS_COMMENT, first frame header |
| `tagged.mp3` | `lame -V 9 --id3v2-only --tt … --ta …` plus an APEv2 footer written by `generate.py` | ID3v2 tag, Xing VBR header with LAME delay/padding, APEv2 footer |
| `chained.ogg` | two `ffmpeg -fflags +bitexact -c:a libvorbis` encodes concatenated | two logical streams (chained Ogg), BOS/EOS pages |
| `co64.m4a` | `afconvert -f m4af -d aac`, then `generate.py` rewrites `stco` to `co64` and gives `mdat` a 64-bit size | 64-bit chunk offsets and a size-1 `mdat`, esds AudioSpecificConfig |

Regenerate with `python3 test/fixtures/audio/inspect/generate.py`; the tool
paths default to this machine's Homebrew and system locations and can be
overridden through `AFCONVERT`, `FLAC`, `LAME` and `FFMPEG`.
